title: Type of Health Insurance
text: Type of Health Insurance What kind of insurance did your household have in 2025? Check all that apply. Health insurance through an employer, including COBRA and retirement coverage (Form 1095-B or 1095-C) Medicaid, Medicare, CHIP, TRICARE, or another government program (Form 1095-B) A plan purchased through HealthCare.gov or a state marketplace (Form 1095-A) LEARN MORE Other insurance (including plans purchased directly from an insurance company, as well as student, catastrophic, and VA insurance)
